item.title: No hijab, no coffee: Iran's bizarre crackdown targets youth
item.description:

The crackdown has also hit restaurants and boutiques in multiple cities. Experts say the closures reflect the regime's broader effort to control public space following deadly protests in January and amid the ongoing war with the US.
